result.Method of Attack: Backdoor code injection via obfuscated PHP code that reads values from cookies and executes them using eval(), enabling remote code execution
result.Impacted Systems: Ivanti EPM Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) product
result.Attack Vector: Use of a cloned and backdoored open source component (csrf-magic) from a counterfeit GitHub repository containing a malicious commit
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious commit ID f7f84f887a5f2e19926a2ad3c48614905629d60b titled '1.0.5 update'
Presence of obfuscated backdoor code between lines 399-407 in csrf-magic.php
Metasploit exploit by researcher 'h00die-gr3y' targeting the backdoor
